lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in a grid-like configuration posterior to the gills, forming approximately four distinct longitudinal rows that increase in spatial separation toward the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a grid of anchor nodes, most prominently visible across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal ridges are present across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient featuring highlights on the dorsal edge and shadowing on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of approximately 10-15 small, medium-luminance blobs irregularly scattered across the anterior and central regions of the fin mask.

other_distinctive_markers: A localized labyrinthine patterning of high-luminance lines exists on the mid-dorsal flank, where standard vertical bands merge and curve into complex, non-linear geometric shapes.
